candidates_considered.name: ITCONS E-Solutions Ltd
candidates_considered.verdict: RESEARCHED, not published. Contract from UP Power Transmission Corporation Ltd, UP State Load Dispatch Centre, to deploy 114 resources for two years; total value Rs 6,94,00,954.24 incl taxes, 01-Oct-2026 to 30-Sep-2028. Read from the filing itself. Against FY26 revenue of Rs 87.74 cr that is 7.9% of one year's sales spread over two years, i.e. about 4% a year - the under-10%-of-sales bucket that reached 2x only 21.4% of the time - and manpower outsourcing to a state utility is routine business for a staffing company, not a step change. One useful constant the filing yields: Rs 6.94 cr / 114 resources / 2 years = Rs 3.04 lakh of contract value per resource per year. FY26 revenue grew 56.7% and PAT 61.8%, but the stock is -52.3% over a year at Rs 261.55. Not published: the trigger is too small against sales.
